text:
olivia (sales): Quick check — kicking off OrbitHealth POC timeline readiness. Trial window target: 2026-04-08 → 2026-05-06 (4w + buffer). Need owners for: env setup (dedicated vs hosted), VPC/network peering, test data ingestion, SSO, and smoke test automation. Success criteria we agreed with SE: p95 latency <800ms @512 tokens, embedding similarity (seed prompts) >= 0.85, and passing 120 smoke assertions.

devin (eng-platform): I can own infra for the dedicated seats. We need VPC peering + outbound egress rules. Which CIDR will OrbitHealth provide? Also confirm whether they need HSM/KMS integration.

samir (eng-sre): I can provision peering as soon as we have CIDR + contact for their infra team. If client plans to send any PHI/PCI, we should move to Private deployment — flagging security.

alesha (devex): I'll own the smoke harness and local dev flows. I'll create repo redwood/orbit-poc and land a smoke runner. Draft smoke config below — feel free to copy:
```
# smoke.yml
- name: basic-generation
  prompt: "Summarize the patient note"
  model: redwood/fast-t4-quant-v2
  assertions:
    - latency_p95 < 800
    - embedding_sim > 0.85
```

joe (se): OrbitHealth will use Okta SSO (SAML). I'll DM SAML metadata + point of contact. They'll upload test records via S3 presigned URLs (10k records). No PCI, but some PHI — they're ok with our private path if necessary.

maya (product): Add a quality metric: for the core triage prompts we want intent match >= 90% (we'll use a seeded eval set). Also please capture any regression signals in the first 1000 responses.

devin (eng-platform): Noted — plan is to pin to redwood/fast-t4-quant-v2 in staging, with automatic fallback to redwood/fast-t4-quant-v1 on OOMs. We'll roll canary 10% for first 24h, then 50% for 48h. I'll create the rollout policy PR and link here.

alesha (devex): quick ping — CR #4527 contains the smoke infra changes (smoke runner + secret loader). Can reviewers from eng-platform + eng-sre take a look? @devin @samir

devin (eng-platform): On it, will review by EOD.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2111190400 (10% -> 24h), created deployment:orbithealth-canary-v1

olivia (sales): Thanks all — owners (summarized): infra=devin, s-re=samir, smoke=alesha, SE=joe, product=maya. Next steps: devin to open PR for rollout policy, alesha to land smoke harness, joe to share SAML + test upload plan. Can we do a quick async check-in Tue 10:00am PT? :calendar:

samir (eng-sre): Tue 10 PT works for me.

devin (eng-platform): Works.

joe (se): I'll be there and will bring the customer's network contact.

olivia (sales): Great — I'll send calendar invite and update the timeline doc. If anyone hits blockers before then, drop here. :pray:
